title: societywale.in. AI enabled housing society management app!
description:
SocietyWale offers a range of features designed to simplify housing society management. Here’s a quick overview:

Member directory: Access flat-wise contacts, emails, and mobile numbers.
Committee directory: Contact details for the chairman, secretary, and treasurer.
Maintenance tracking: Monitor rates, paid vs pending dues by flat/month, and collection history.
Payment claims: Members can submit payment details for committee verification.
Society bank/UPI account publishing: Share payment details securely.
Expense logging: Track committee spending easily.
Notices & society rules: Post, edit, and notify members in-app.
Complaint tracker: Open, update, and close complaints with clear status.
Financial reports: Generate monthly/annual branded PDF reports.
Audit document storage: Keep important documents organized.
Analytics dashboard: For admin insights.
AI tools: WhatsApp dues reminder drafts, AI notice writer, and committee digest.
